999008199.text: ふー、体を動かしたら少しすっきりした！

localizations.en: Whew, getting my blood pumping again helped! I feel so much better!

999008199.text: わんぱくな王女様っすね……

localizations.en: You really are quite the spirited princess...

999008199.text:
でもクレオはなんで軍に入ったの？
ランターナには天命の規則もないよね？

localizations.en: So why did you join the military, Creo? Lantarna doesn't have a Divine Calling system like we do, right?

999008199.text:
うん。私には兄が二人いてね、オルペウス兄さんは
内政ができて、リヒャルト兄さんは、まぁ、器用

localizations.en: Right. I have two older brothers—Orpheus handles domestic affairs, and Richard is... well, capable at just about everything.

999008199.text:
それで私は何ができるかっていうと……
武芸については、高い評価をもらってたの

localizations.en: So when it came to what I was good at... I'd always gotten high praise for martial arts.

999008199.text:
昔からお城の中で過ごすより
抜け出して外を走り回るのが好きだったのだよ

localizations.en: Even as a kid, I much preferred sneaking out of the castle and running around outside to staying cooped up in there.

999008199.text: はー、なるほど、鏑矢さんと似たような感じ

localizations.en: Ahh, I see—sounds like you and Kaburaya are cut from the same cloth.

999008199.text:
それにみんなの面倒を見るのも好きだし、
部下たちと過ごすのも好きなんだ

localizations.en: And I love looking after people. Spending time with my unit, being there for them—that means everything to me.

999008199.text:
同じ部隊の仲間は戦友であり、
家族のようなものでもありますもんね

localizations.en: Your fellow soldiers really do become like family, don't they? Comrades in arms, in the truest sense.

999008199.text: うん、だから……

白夜の騎士ユナとかあなたみたいな
強くて素敵な淑女になりたくて努力してるの

localizations.en: I've been working hard to become someone strong and wonderful—like Juna of the Midnight Sun, or like you.

999008199.text:
頑張って筋肉をつけたんだよ！
ほら、王女の筋肉を見たまえよ～

localizations.en: I've been putting in the work to build up my strength! Here, behold—the muscles of a princess!

999008199.text:
わ、ほんとだ！　めっちゃ筋肉ついてる！
これが、あの強さの秘訣なんすね……！

localizations.en: Whoa, you're not kidding! Those are some serious muscles! So that's the secret behind all that power...!

999008199.text:
私の筋肉も見事だと、ほめている、称えている。
ヒューッて

localizations.en: My muscles are also impressive. Worth praising. Worth celebrating. ...Just saying.

999008199.text: 二人とも、立派な筋肉ですこと……

localizations.en: You're both absolutely jacked, I'll give you that...

999008199.text: 随分、奥まで来たわね

localizations.en: We've come quite a ways in, haven't we.

999008199.text: 求める素材まではもう少し！

localizations.en: Just a little further and we should have everything we need!

999008199.text:
でも、奥地ほど強力な魔物がいるのが
世の常だから。気を付けていきましょうね

localizations.en: Though the deeper you go, the stronger the monsters tend to be—that's just how it works. Let's stay careful.

999008199.text:
待って。奥から音がする。
金属音、これは……

localizations.en: Hold on. There's something up ahead. Metal on metal—that sound is...

999008199.text:
ええ、武器……しかも長物の音。
誰かが魔物の群れと戦っているみたい

localizations.en: A weapon—and a long one, by the sound of it. Someone's fighting off a monster horde.

999008199.text:
……ほんとだ、そう言われてみると
戦っている音が聞こえてくる、かも

localizations.en: ...You're right. Now that you mention it, I can just barely make out the sounds of a fight.

999008199.text:
助けてあげなくちゃ！
急ごう！

localizations.en: We have to help! Come on, let's move!

999008199.text: フッ！
見つけた！
なんて速い攻撃……！

必要ないかもだけど、相手は数も多いし！
そこの素敵なお姉さん、助けさせて！

localizations.en: You might not need it, but there are a lot of them! Mind if we lend a hand?

999008199.text:
ありがとう！　じゃあ、お姉さん、
お言葉に甘えちゃおっかな？

localizations.en: Thank you! In that case, I'll gladly take you up on that!

999008199.text: 来るっ！！
